confirmation_fields.data.action_url: Optional URL for completing or reviewing the confirmation action
confirmation_fields.data.confirmation_required: true when explicit confirmation is required (intermediate state, exit 0)
confirmation_fields.data.confirmation_token: Token to pass via --confirmation-token only after explicit user approval
confirmation_fields.data.expires_in: Seconds until the confirmation token expires
confirmation_fields.data.message: Human-readable confirmation instruction from the service
confirmation_fields.data.summary: Operation summary to review before confirming

success_fields.data.deleted: Present for --id; true when the selected message was permanently deleted
success_fields.data.deleted_count: Present for --all; number of messages permanently deleted from trash
